== File server shares ==

The shares below are published from FS01. The admin shares (C$, ADMIN$,
IPC$) are created by Windows and are not listed here.

 Share name   Resource                        Remark
 Projects     D:\Projects                     Team projects
 Scans        D:\Scans                        Scanner drop folder

Request access through the service desk. Do not map drives to the
admin shares.
